answer: Each newcomer enters only behind a copper surety bond: an established sponsor locks 100 copper in escrow for ten epochs, and each further identity that sponsor backs costs 25 copper more, a fixed delta that never resets. If auditors prove the newcomer a puppet, the bond is melted and the forfeiture is written into the public fable, a signed chronicle barring that sponsor until cleared. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 sponsors locking 100,000 copper, while one sponsor backing all 1,000 pays 12,587,500 copper; an honest user needs one sponsor and 100 copper, returned in full.
